description: Search the Quran for a keyword across ayahs (verses). Returns matching verses (up to 30) with their surah (chapter) and ayah number. Defaults to the en.asad English translation; pass another edition to search a different translation or Arabic (quran-uthmani).

keyword.description: Word or phrase to search for.

surah.description: Restrict to a surah number, or 'all' for the whole Quran (default).

name: search_quran
